Wählen Sie beim Erstellen einer Rechnung: When creating an invoice, choose Deposit invoice as its title and enter a project/site reference. Issue the document and record the payment. Partially paid deposits cannot yet be selected.
Unter Ausgaben (auf dem Smartphone unter: Under Expenses (under More on a phone), enter the supplier, date, gross amount and category. Assign the expense to a project/site reference. Only completed entries count towards totals; overnight shifts are assigned to their start date.
